import.help: A Claude Code session from ~/.claude/projects or a Codex session from ~/.codex/sessions. Keys, emails and home folder names are removed before it is kept.
import.tooLarge: This file is larger than 32 MB. Export a shorter session.
import.notSession: This is not a Claude Code or Codex session file.
import.done: Imported. The session is now open in New.
import.limits: Adds one failure to New (.jsonl, up to 32 MB).

proposal.draft: Draft with a model (paid, uses your model key)
proposal.confirm: One model call, at most ${{budget}}. The session text sent is the cleaned copy shown here.
proposal.start: Draft it, up to the cap
proposal.drafting: The model is drafting what should have happened...
proposal.noQuote: No quote found. Check it yourself.
proposal.dropped_one: {{count}} suggestion had no quote found in the session and was left out.
proposal.dropped_other: {{count}} suggestions had no quote found in the session and were left out.
proposal.proving: Proving the task. The reference must pass, a do-nothing agent and the recorded mistake must fail.
proposal.saved: Saved to {{benchmark}} without the readiness check.

trace.draft: Draft a task from a session
